Scene:
发现了夹竹桃有毒。别人看到他，很快给他吃一个灵芝。神农一吃就觉得比较好。然后，他继续写他发现的信息。会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 发现了夹竹桃有毒：it is unclear that夹竹桃refers to黄色的花
- 别人看到他：另外一个人，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
- 会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能不能吃：也会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能吃，哪个植物不能吃

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Reference): 别人看到他：一个人看到他，This is the first mention of this helper, so use a full noun phrase to introduce the person. “别人” means other people in contrast with a particular person or group, but no such contrast has been established here. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention] [teacher rule: bieren]
Run 2: 别人：一个男人，This is a new, unspecified character. Use an indefinite noun phrase rather than a word that distinguishes “other people” from a stated person or group. [teacher rule: bieren]
Run 3: 别人：一个男人，`别人` distinguishes other people from a person already being contrasted; it cannot introduce a new rescuer here. [teacher rule: bieren]

output.reason: All runs identify the misuse of “别人” for introducing a new helper and replace it with an acceptable indefinite noun phrase.
